methodology: Scored each candidate against the hermes-agent source code at /home/sudosudo/.hermes/hermes-agent. Verified existence via grep/class searches. V=can verify with existing tests/code, C=how many photonic components natively support, R=reliability in codebase history.

rankings.rationale: PluginLoader.discover() and iter_plugin_dirs() exist in plugin_loader.py. Hot-reload supported via hermes_cli/plugins.py. Multiple discovery paths (bundled, user, project, pip). Most grounded candidate.
Middleware system fully exists with VALID_MIDDLEWARE, observer/middleware payload schemas, pre/post dispatch hooks. MiddlewarePlugin class doesn't exist but the contract is established.
Config system (hermes config set/get) exists. plugin_storage.py and plugin_loader.py support config manipulation. on_load hook pattern partially established via plugin_capabilities.
PluginContext.data exists and memory plugin has 8+ backends (mem0, holographic, honcho, supermemory, etc.). FrontierStore doesn't exist but the PluginContext scoping pattern is verified.
ToolRegistry exists (tools/registry.py) with register/query patterns. PlannerPlugin and DAG.save/load don't exist. ToolRegistry provides partial corroboration only.
CircuitBreaker exists in test files (test_stream_stale_circuit_breaker.py, test_tirith_security.py). CircuitBreakerRegistry and EvolutionEngine don't exist.
Audit logging exists in gateway/session_context.py and gateway/relay/adapter.py but no AuditAdaptPlugin or AuditLog.query API. Minimal grounding.
AgentTrace doesn't exist as a class. Some tracing infrastructure in gateway code. Low corroboration.
EvolutionEngine doesn't exist. Plugin ABC exists in hermes_cli plugin_capabilities.py. Only the Plugin ABC side provides any corroboration.
No replanning infrastructure exists. Timeout handling exists in cron/async patterns but not as a planner feature.
Neither AgentLoop nor FrontierStore exist. Memory plugin exists but FrontierStore.prefetch pattern is entirely theoretical.
AgentLoop doesn't exist. Self-reflection pattern has no grounding in codebase.
No swarm or distributed dispatcher components exist. Zero corroboration from photonic ecosystem.
Neither component exists. PipelineExecutor has no grounding.
PipelinePlugin and DAG.save/load don't exist. No pipeline assembly infrastructure.
SelfImprover doesn't exist. Code self-modification has no grounding.

FrontierStore doesn't exist. Tier promotion mechanism is theoretical.
FrontierEntry doesn't exist. Cross-agent memory sharing has no grounding.
EvolutionEngine doesn't exist. Self-generation trigger is entirely theoretical.

quorum_check.note: Only voter 2 scores above 0.60 threshold. With 3 voters needed at 0.67 quorum, this single high-scoring candidate cannot carry the decision alone. Top 5 are buildable on existing infrastructure but advanced AGI features require significant new implementation.
